argv:
set -eu
mkdir -p "$PCNODE_OUT/CPS1MaterialIncidence"
python3 - <<'PYLINKS'
import os
from pathlib import Path
src=Path(os.environ['PCNODE_LIB'])/'lib';dst=Path(os.environ['PCNODE_OUT'])
for p in src.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file():
  q=dst/p.relative_to(src);q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  if not q.exists():q.symlink_to(p)
PYLINKS
export LEAN_PATH="$PCNODE_OUT:$PCNODE_SRC/src:$PCNODE_LIB/lib"
export CPS1_REUSED_ROOT_NAMES="$PCNODE_SRC/src/paid-names-native-registered-body-runtime.txt"
export CPS1_AUDIT_PREFIX="$PCNODE_OUT/ExecuteAudit"
compile_gate() {
  gate_module="$1"
  gate_source="$2"
  gate_output="$PCNODE_OUT/$gate_module.olean"
  if test -L "$gate_output"; then rm -- "$gate_output"; fi
  gate_saved="$PCNODE_WORK/proof-gates/c4ad49762438a8c5dbaea3173941c69452214ff2de1c6eeae111f63233947286/$gate_module.olean"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$gate_output")" "$(dirname "$gate_saved")"
  if test -f "$gate_saved.sha256" && (cd "$(dirname "$gate_saved")" && sha256sum -c "$(basename "$gate_saved").sha256" >/dev/null 2>&1); then
    cp "$gate_saved" "$gate_output"
    printf 'GATE reused %s\n' "$gate_module" | tee -a "$PCNODE_OUT/math-gates.log"
  else
    lean --trust=0 -DElab.async=false -DwarningAsError=true -M32000 -j1 -o "$gate_output" "$PCNODE_SRC/src/$gate_source"
    cp "$gate_output" "$gate_saved"
    (cd "$(dirname "$gate_saved")" && sha256sum "$(basename "$gate_saved")" > "$(basename "$gate_saved").sha256")
    printf 'GATE fresh %s\n' "$gate_module" | tee -a "$PCNODE_OUT/math-gates.log"
  fi
}
compile_gate "SaturationMonoid/NoIslandNoMagic/Consciousness/Immortality/Embodied/Molecule/CPS1Personalized2025/Runtime/RegisteredBody" "SaturationMonoid/NoIslandNoMagic/Consciousness/Immortality/Embodied/Molecule/CPS1Personalized2025/Runtime/RegisteredBody.lean"
lean --trust=0 -DElab.async=false -DwarningAsError=true -M32000 -j1 -o "$PCNODE_OUT/NativeRegisteredBodyRuntimeAuditTools.olean" "$PCNODE_SRC/src/NativeRegisteredBodyRuntimeAuditTools.lean"
lean --trust=0 -DElab.async=false -DwarningAsError=true -M32000 -j1 -o "$PCNODE_OUT/ExecuteAudit.olean" "$PCNODE_SRC/src/ExecuteAudit.lean"
lean --trust=0 -DElab.async=false -DwarningAsError=true -M32000 -j1 "$PCNODE_SRC/src/Axioms.lean" > "$PCNODE_OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1
